reverse_factor_application: log2 PG corrected = raw log2 PG - (reference - log2 H)
PCA_method: Raw PCA fitted once and reused for both corrected branches

Raw_PCA_details.corrected_data: Projected onto original Raw components; not a second PCA fit
Raw_PCA_details.feature_selection: Raw detection >=70% of 39 retained samples and Raw SD>1e-8
Raw_PCA_details.missing_imputation: Each selected protein's Raw median, identical for Raw and Corrected
Raw_PCA_details.centering: Each selected protein's Raw mean after Raw-only missing imputation
Raw_PCA_details.PC_axis_orientation: Raw loading with largest absolute magnitude is positive
